plan.title: Gap escalation to upstream feedback (feedback:file + skill)

narratives.Description: Add a feedback:file command that drafts and dedups a framework-gap issue against deftai/directive, gated behind a confirmation prompt and consumer-only guards. Add a deft-directive-feedback skill for the conversational batched session-end flow.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add a feedback module that builds the gap template, dedups against existing upstream issues via the scm shim, and files only after explicit confirmation.
- Guard against filing inside the maintainer repo and add tests asserting no issue is created without confirmation.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive consumer, I want to file a deduped framework-gap issue after confirming, so that directive's shortfalls reach maintainers instead of dying in my session.
narratives.Traces: #1709 gap escalation (child 5); mirrors article-review confirmation gate.

narrative.Acceptance: The command drafts a framework-gap issue and rejects filing until the user explicitly confirms.
When run inside the maintainer repo, the feedback path emits no upstream issue.
Duplicate detection rejects filing when a matching upstream issue already exists.

expected_outputs: feedback:file command with dedup, confirmation gate, and consumer-only guard
deft-directive-feedback skill for the batched conversational flow
